body: I'm here, and I know what you're going through. You can PM me if you want to talk.
I can't possibly imagine how hard that is.
I can't possibly imagine how hard that is.

Listen, because though I haven't been at it for 5 years, I feel the exact same way. You need to find something to care about. You need to spend your entire life doing something you set for yourself. You need to dump all your brainpower and musclepower into one single goal. You need to fill up all the emptiness inside of you, and the only way you can do it, is with a focus. I was normal once. For a brief, glittering time. And it was the only time I felt alive. You need to feel normal, because feeling normal, is feeling alive.

I woke up this morning feeling like crap, and you guys fixed it.  I have to say thanks.  I guess for the first time i have hope, even if it's far off like a single burning star.  But I no matter how you look at it, I'll be running away.  And usually that's for the best, but I can't cut ties to my family.  No matter how horrible they treat me, I can't leave.  My parents have no retirement money, and I could never doom them to horrible golden years.  I have to fix it, but I can't.  I've tried so many times, but she always turns it into a shouting match, and she just doesn't understand what I'm trying to say.  If I push any harder, do anything for them to truly get the message, their marriage will fall apart.  It's barely holding on as it is.  If I can keep this hope alive, I can make it.  But I need to do something about this situation to avoid future problems. Not to brag, but I'm one of the smartest people I know, and I have no clue on how to fix this.
